notes.title: Multiple language support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37906547/89c435c923265e9dba2751c5bdd257ed1156a6d1.jpg[/img]

Language barrier? No worries!
Zombo Buster Advance will support multiple languages for you!

List of supported languages:
- English
- Portuguese (Brazil)
- Spanish (Spain)
- Russian
- Polish
- German
- French
- Italian
- Simp. Chinese
- Trad. Chinese
- Japanese
- Korean
